crossRefs.note: God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Paddan Aram, and blessed him.
Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spoke with him, a pillar of stone. He poured out a drink offering on it…
When you have departed from me today, then you will find two men by Rachel’s tomb, on the border of Benjamin at Zelzah.…
They took Absalom and cast him into a great pit in the forest, and raised over him a very great heap of stones. Then…
Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself the pillar which is in the king’s valley, for he said…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Rachel
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of Joseph and Benjamin

translations.web: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. The same is the Pillar of Rachel’s grave to this day.
translations.bsb: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave; it marks Rachel’s tomb to this day.
translations.kjv: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that is the pillar of Rachel's grave unto this day.
translations.asv: And Jacob set up a pillar upon her grave: the same is the Pillar of Rachel's grave unto this day.
